description: Dostupnosť verejnej kanalizácie is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by minzp.sk. Rate of sewerage of Slovak municipalities in 2023. For each municipality, the percentage of the population connected to the public sewerage system and the number of unconnected inhabitants in the municipality shall be reported. The source of the data is the statistical survey ZberVaK. Lower availability of public sewerage poses environmental and potential health risks. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Availability of public sewerage" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Zmena klímy. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
